# Release gate

Lead with `PASS` or `BLOCKED`. The human release owner owns the decision. Every item below needs
either evidence-backed `PASS` or an explicit `N/A` with a reason; missing or merely asserted evidence
is blocking.

Release readiness does not authorize a production effect. A production candidate proceeds through the
separate, later `production-change-gate` with this packet as input.

## Required evidence

- [ ] **Candidate identity** — exact version, reviewed SHA, target environment, release notes, and
      immutable artifact identity are recorded.
- [ ] **Merge readiness** — attach the `merge-gate` PASS for that SHA. Do not load or re-run the sibling
      gate here.
- [ ] **Build once, promote** — the artifact validated in the lower environment is the artifact that
      will ship; no unreviewed rebuild occurs between test and release.
- [ ] **Compatibility and data recovery** — applicable database, schema, and configuration changes are
      ordered for mixed-version operation. Record rollback, restore, or forward-recovery evidence and
      any irreversible data effect. Do not require every migration to be independently reversible when
      the safe contract is expand, verify, then retire later.
- [ ] **Risk controls, when applicable** — risky behavior has a tested safe default, feature flag,
      bounded rollout, or another named control. Mark this `N/A` rather than inventing a flag for a
      change that does not need one.
- [ ] **Rollback or recovery** — exact human-owned steps, known-good artifact/state, prerequisites,
      maximum recovery window, and rehearsal evidence are attached. A rollback claim remains
      `[unverified]` for the target until exercised or otherwise proven there.
- [ ] **Health and abort criteria** — predeclare success signals, observation window, abort thresholds,
      and who decides to stop.
- [ ] **Operational readiness, when applicable** — changed runtime behavior has current monitoring,
      paging/runbook disposition, capacity assumptions, and a named operator. Absence of a new alert is
      acceptable only with a reason tied to the change.
- [ ] **Comms and ownership** — window, on-call coverage, stakeholder cadence, release owner, and recovery
      owner are named.
- [ ] **Production boundary** — for production, record that authorization is still pending the separate
      effect-bound change gate. This gate never dispatches a workflow or performs a deploy.

## Verdict

```text
release-gate: PASS | BLOCKED
Candidate: <version — reviewed SHA — immutable artifact>
Target and strategy: <environment — rollout strategy or N/A>
Rollback/recovery: <steps — evidence — owner — maximum window>
Health/abort: <signals — observation window — thresholds — decision owner>
N/A items: <item — reason, or none>
Blocking items: <each missing or failed predicate and what clears it>
Production authorization: <pending production-change-gate | not a production target>
```

## Boundary

This skill consumes recorded merge, artifact, observability, and platform evidence; it does not invoke
their producing skills. Workflow definition belongs to `ci-actions`. Production execution remains
human-owned or protected-automation-owned after separate authorization.
